newsitem.title: USA: Community Care of America sees Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Community Care of America sees Q4 loss.

text.p: Community Care of America Inc said on Monday it expected to report a loss in the fourth quarter due to write-offs, one-time charges and adjustments.
The company said these write-offs and charges could total between $8 million and $14 million before income tax benefits.

"We are evaluating the potential write-off of the deferred offering costs related to our stock offering which was not completed in 1996, alternative courses of action with respect to the previously announced Memorial transaction which could result in a write-off, as well as non-recurring charges and adjustments," President Gary Singleton said.
In April, the company said it postponed a secondary offering of 3.1 million shares.

The healthcare provider said it believed it was prudent to postpone the offering while it took certain corrective actions in one of its Iowa facilities to ensure that it continued to receive Medicare and Medicaid funding.
Company officials were not immediately available to comment further.
Community also said it obtained and closed on a $15 million secured line of credit with Daiwa Securities America.
